title: Introducing the NewsPaLM MBR and QE Dataset: LLM-Generated High-Quality Parallel Data Outp
summary: Uses the NewsPaLM dataset from our open-source release — LLM-generated parallel en-de/de-en data produced with MBR decoding and QE reranking, at sentence and multi-sentence blob level — to prove that curated LLM-generated training data can outperform web-crawled corpora for our translation model training pipelines.
